text:
jamie_support: heads up — customer ACME reported invoice counts way higher than what our dashboard shows for their embedding + rerank job. invoice shows ~1.2M vector units for last month, dashboard usage ~180k. they say they only ran one nightly batch. attaching request_id and snippet below. can billing/infra triage?

kevin_billing: thanks — can you paste the request_id + sample payload and the invoice line item id? also any request headers (X-Request-ID / batch-id) would help.

jamie_support: request_id: req_01GZ9ABCD1234 
invoice_line: inv_0a1b2c3d
batch-id header: batch-2026-02-10-01
sample payload (trimmed):
```json
{
  "model": "text-embedding-ada-002",
  "input": ["Short product desc 1","Long product desc 2... (5000 chars)","Search query A"],
  "rerank_config": { "mode": "pairwise", "pairs_per_input": 3 }
}
```

jamie_support: their pipeline uses our async bulk endpoint with per-file batching (1000 inputs/file). They suspect truncation on long descriptions and that rerank pairwise counts doubled. customer says they didn’t call rerank separately.

alex_ml: quick theory: pairwise rerank semantics generate additional pairwise comparisons which we historically meter differently. If client used the async bulk endpoint + enabled rerank within same request, our metering could have counted both per-input embeddings + pairwise pairs as full embedding units (instead of a smaller rerank unit). Also truncation can cause a different path that triggers per-token fallback counting.

alex_ml: can you grab the raw metering events for batch-2026-02-10-01? specifically events: embed.create, rerank.pairwise and any fallback.token_count records. if we see a 1:n explosion matching n_inputs*(n_inputs-1)/2 that’s our smoking gun.

jamie_support: asked customer for the raw CSV (they agreed). meanwhile attaching a snippet from our metering log for that batch:
```
[2026-02-10T01:02:03Z] batch=2026-02-10-01 event=embed.create inputs=1000 charged_units=1000 req=req_01GZ9ABCD1234
[2026-02-10T01:02:10Z] batch=2026-02-10-01 event=rerank.pairwise inputs=1000 pairs=499500 charged_units=499500 req=req_01GZ9ABCD1234
[2026-02-10T01:02:12Z] batch=2026-02-10-01 event=embed.create fallback.token_count=120000 charged_units=120000 req=req_01GZ9ABCD1234
```

kevin_billing: whoa. that rerank.pairwise charged_units number would explain the delta. Did our dashboard aggregate exclude pairwise units by design? we had an older roll that stopped surfacing pairwise counts in the per-job chart to reduce noise, but invoices still include raw metering. Need confirmation.

metering-bot: note: dashboard_agg_v2 (deployed 2026-01-22) filters out meter.event=="rerank.pairwise" by default for per-job charts. Invoices consume raw_meter_events.

kevin_billing: OK that matches. root cause: dashboard filtering vs invoice raw-event billing mismatch. two action items: 1) billing: issue one-time credit to ACME to reconcile difference while we fix presentation/consistency. 2) infra: consider changing invoice definition or dashboard to surface pairwise impact and add a warning about rerank mode.

alex_ml: also immediate product action: update async bulk docs to call out that enabling pairwise rerank will generate O(n^2) charged units and will appear on invoice. we should add a guard in the async endpoint that warns (or requires confirmation) when rerank.mode==pairwise and inputs > 200.

jamie_support: customer is ok with credit while we fix docs. they provided their CSV and I uploaded to secure ticket: ticket_9876.

kevin_billing: credit approved for delta amount. I'll open billing case and attach metering logs + invoice diff. Can you add the recommended doc text and a short UX toast for the console team? @sara_prod can you prioritize the docs + console message?

sara_prod: got it — will draft docs note and a small console banner that appears when 'pairwise' is selected in rerank config. aim for deploy next week.

alex_ml: engineering follow-up: I'll add a safety check to metering pipeline to tag pairwise events and emit a separate invoice line (so it's transparent) and add a UI toggle to show/hide pairwise detail. I'll open an RFC/PR.

jamie_support: thanks everyone — marking this thread as escalated. I’ll update ACME once credit is posted and when we have doc/console changes. :thumbsup:

kevin_billing: moving to billing queue. ticket_9876 updated. closing internal support loop after credit posts.
